# Jemani

> Jemani is a premium executive mobility service. Public pages cover the marketing site, account entry, and the Android test APK. Authenticated product areas are not listed here.

Jemani connects travelers with selected partner companies for airport transfers, business trips, and occasions that need extra care. The public web experience is available today; the Android APK is a test build (not on Google Play).

## Public pages

- [Home](https://jemani.vercel.app/): Marketing landing — fleet overview, how booking works, and links to sign in or create an account
- [Sign in](https://jemani.vercel.app/entrar): Sign in to an existing Jemani account
- [Create account](https://jemani.vercel.app/cadastrar): Register a new Jemani account
- [Android test APK](https://jemani.vercel.app/downloads/jemani-android.apk): Download the public test APK for Android

## Optional

- [App version manifest](https://jemani.vercel.app/downloads/versao-android.json): Public JSON with the current Android APK version metadata
- [AI catalog](https://jemani.vercel.app/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable list of the same public discovery resources
